name: ecommerce-payment-operations-livewire
description: Livewire 4 storefront surface for the three payment things a shopper legitimately touches: paying, seeing what happened to their own payment, and removing a saved instrument.
features: A pay control that authorizes, and captures when the deployment says so
One idempotency key, minted when the payment step is entered and held for every retry
A double-clicked pay button that authorizes once and charges once
An in-flight first attempt answered as still processing, never as an error
A permanent conflict that refuses rather than quietly starting a second payment
A decline recorded as a fact, with a short code and a fresh key for the next attempt
Amounts resolved server-side from a host reference, never sent by a browser
No instrument anywhere: no property, no field, and a refusal if one arrives as a token
Provider-neutral: no SDK, no provider name in src, and the host owns the widget
A receipt folded from the append-only ledger, scoped to the customer who paid
Saved instruments a customer can list and remove, and can never add
Every public property locked, enforced by reflection over every registered component
Integer minor units throughout, formatted by string arithmetic
A live region announcing every outcome, error and state change
